name: time-picker
title: Time picker
description: A time of day you type (read back with its part of the day, so 02:30 and 14:30 can't be mixed up), dial by part with the arrows, or choose from slots: the toggle's latching keys every `step` minutes inside opening hours, unavailable ones quiet, Now under them. 12 or 24 hours by locale, hour / minute / second, a window across midnight, a zone engraved after the time, the end of a pair saying each slot's length. DatePicker takes it with `time`.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/time-picker.md. SwiftUI: MetalTimePicker in the MetalUI Swift package.
